page_title: GIR 1-0 CEL | Girona v Celta Vigo 27/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Portu (Girona), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
90+7' A quickly taken corner by Girona.
90+6' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. It will be a corner kick for Celta Vigo.
90+5' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul after Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+1' 1 - 0 Yangel Herrera (Girona) got the ball under control on the edge of the 18-yard box after collecting a pass and sends it deep into the net off the right-hand post.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Portu (Girona) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
86' Portu (Girona) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
85' Carlos Dotor goes off the pitch and Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) comes on.
83' Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Isidro Diaz de Mera who sees an offensive foul.
82' Juanpe (Girona) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.

81' Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
79' Substitution. Arnau Martinez walks off the pitch and Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) comes on as a substitute.
78' Good movement by Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
77' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
77' The referee is firm and issues Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) a deserved yellow card.
75' It is time for a substitution. Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is on for Jonathan Bamba.
72' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
70' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
70' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
68' Girona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
67' Michel decides to make a substitution. Artem Dovbyk will be replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
67' Portu (Girona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ivan Martin.
66' CHANCE! Yan Couto (Girona) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
66' The total number of attempts is 6:3.
63' Aleix Garcia (Girona) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
60' Aleix Garcia (Girona) tries to find Ivan Martin, but he puts too much power on the pass.
59' An attempted cross from Aleix Garcia (Girona) is cleared.
58' The game is interrupted now, Yan Couto (Girona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
56' Girona couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
55' Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera had an easy-decision to make.
53' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
52' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
51' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
51' Dangerous play by Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo). Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Girona.

47' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
47' Now Girona have a corner.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+10' Isidro Diaz de Mera has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+9' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45+8' The game is interrupted now, Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45+7' Yan Couto (Girona) has tested the patience of referee Isidro Diaz de Mera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45+6' Savio (Girona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vicente Guaita intercepts the ball.
45+5' A cross from Ivan Martin (Girona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
45+4' Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
45+3' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
45+2' David Lopez is substituted due to injury. Michel gives a chance to Juanpe (Girona).
45+1' David Lopez (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
45' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle. Yangel Herrera (Girona) commits a foul after dangerous play.

43' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Celta Vigo will take a corner.
42' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

42' Ivan Martin (Girona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Girona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
41' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) sends a cross into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga comes off his line to gather the ball.
41' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) produces a promising shot towards the left side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Paulo Gazzaniga thwarts him and the score remains the same.
38' A pass into the penalty area from Savio (Girona) is intercepted by the defence.
38' The percentage of ball possession is – 70:30.
35' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

34' Savio (Girona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Girona are going to take it.
32' A long ball forward to Yangel Herrera (Girona) is intercepted.
31' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.

29' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the middle of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
28' Savio (Girona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
27' Savio (Girona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
24' Yan Couto (Girona) commits a rough foul. Isidro Diaz de Mera stops the game and makes a call.
24' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) is able to continue to play.
21' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
21' Savio (Girona) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
19' Yangel Herrera (Girona) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
17' Savio (Girona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
17' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
16' Yan Couto (Girona) was too forceful with his tackle and Isidro Diaz de Mera interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
13' The match can continue after the interruption.
9' The game is interrupted.
7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
7' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ivan Martin (Girona) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball goes out of play. Girona are awarded a corner kick.
5' Yangel Herrera (Girona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Isidro Diaz de Mera blows for a foul.
4' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
4' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Girona.
3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Girona comes to nothing.
3' Yan Couto (Girona) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball goes out of play. Girona are awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Girona will have the kick-off.
Isidro Diaz de Mera was nominated as the referee for this game.
